race.description: Barrington Coast Vets Super Mdn Hcp
race.comment: A real lottery. STORMY MARTINI (5) has raced twice and been runner-up each time, the latest effort a near miss over 1200m at Coffs Harbour. Has improvement in store and can go one better without surprising. TRULY GRAPHIC (7) got going late to finish second when fresh from a spell over 1000m at Kempsey recently. Will be hard to hold out over a bit more ground today. KIWI HARMONY (18) is an each-way hope first-up after a three-month break. SUNNY QUARTERS (11) made a fine effort last start when she finished a close second at Port Macquarie over 1200m. Handy draw will assist and she should be right in contention here.
